name: Music EQ
author: taiku666
description: Small 4-bar audio-reactive equalizer (cava) with a scrolling now-playing text for any MPRIS player (playerctl).

barWidget.description: 4-bar audio-reactive equalizer (cava) with a scrolling now-playing text. Click opens a small player panel.

schema.label: Player
schema.description: Which MPRIS player to follow, passed to playerctl --player. A name (spotify), a priority list (spotify,firefox) or %any. Empty follows the first available player. See playerctl -l.

schema.label: Ignore players
schema.description: Comma-separated players never to follow, passed to playerctl --ignore-player, e.g. firefox,chromium.

schema.label: Bar colour
schema.description: Base colour for the 4 bars (drawn in 4 shades of it): a theme role (accent, foreground, urgent, muted), a theme hue (red, orange, yellow, green, cyan, blue, magenta), a terminal colour color0-color15, or a hex colour like #ff8800.

schema.label: Max text width (px)
schema.description: Longer titles scroll inside this width.

schema.label: Noise gate
schema.description: Levels below this (0-100) are shown as flat, so quiet passages don't jitter.
